title: Create: Windmill Speed Control
description: A small Create add-on mod that adds a new windmill bearing block allowing to change the rotation speed. Purely cosmetic, no logic modified.
body:
# Create: Windmill Speed Control

### Ever built a beautiful large windmill in Create only to watch it spin like a helicopter?

**Create: Windmill Speed Control** adds a new custom windmill bearing that lets you adjust the **visual rotation speed** of your windmills while keeping their mechanical performance unchanged.

## ⚙️ Features

* Adjustable visual speed factor (10% - 100%)
* Independent rotation direction control (vanilla)
* No changes to generated Stress Units (SU)
* No changes to gameplay balance
* Compatible with standard Create windmill contraptions
* Fully synchronized in multiplayer
* Dedicated server compatible

Perfect for builders who want large decorative windmills to look more natural without sacrificing Create's mechanics.

## 🧩 Requirements

* Minecraft == 1.21.1
* NeoForge >= 21.1.230
* Create == 6.0.10

## 🛠 Use

- can be crafted from a basic `windmill bearing` and adding a `brass ingot` on top + a `precision mechanism` below (cf JEI)
- block friendly name : `Windmill Speed Control Bearing`
- block full name : `create_windmill_speed_control:visual_windmill_bearing`

## 🧭 Roadmap

- dedicated texture
- improve parameter icons placement
- Fabric version (coming soon) 
- Forge version (coming soon)
- increase Create version range compatibility (coming soon)
- Minecraft 1.20.1 compatibility

## ⚠️ Notes

- This mod requires Create to function. 
- It is currently in active development, and new features could be added over time.
- [Iris Flywheel Compat](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris-flw-compat/versions) mod is highly recommended if you play with shaders, to prevent rendering issues with Create rotating blocks/structures.
